description.en: A handmade, 18 karat gold necklace. Worn on its own it adds a touch of minimalistic elegance to any outfit. In combination with your favourite pendants it becomes the expression of your personal style and your story.  As all LURI pieces, this necklace is crafted entirely by hand.
